definition: Unfilled positions or vacancy conditions cited in compensation or staffing decisions.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 8 distinct documented vacancy pressure implementation events across 8 municipalities in 4 states. Unfilled positions or vacancy conditions cited in compensation or staffing decisions. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
